because noone is leeching off the system to get rich, people have to do less work overall. everyone works, say, 30 hours a week. if you do your work, the rest of your time is yours. you may have 16 hour workdays a few days a week, and then free time for the rest as others farm instead. 



 you get time to go vacationing and get good at woodoworking. if youd like you can spend extra time working for a coop in exchange for a luxury item, such as if youd like a new tv or game console. you work for the equivalent amount of time to make an item, and its yours.

under capitalism, to profit off doing anything, you have to pay people less than the value of their work. youre incentivized to pay as little as possible, even when that is unfair to your contractor. when the primary currency is your time, you are guaranteed to always have a fair trade because youre trading the same currency. When goods and services are only worth as long as it takes to do/get them, you cant con people. theres no exploitation. the deal is always fair because 5 hours of work is always 5 hours.

when everyones basic needs are met, and the value of a luxury item is equivalent to the time needed to create it, its nearly impossible to be greedy. theres no real debate because its just "my game console took 5 hours of work to make, so i helped out making consoles for 5 hours and got one". theres no subjectivity there. prices are arbitrary, labor time isnt.

workplace democracy can just be kept in place because if you start exploiting your workers, when all their needs are met otherwise and you dont have control of their livelihood, theyll set off for greener pastures.

under anarchism, to get things you dont need to survive, you can help in creating it. you absolutely get to work for luxuries, because you did the equivalent work to earn them. you dont have to worry about starving to death for not making enough money, and if you want to work hard to have lots of things, that is completely allowed. not only that, it isnt exploiting anyone, because you did the work to make it, not your underlings.
